'''Vandin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with at least one floating [[tibanna gas platform]] that housed [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Miner/Legends|miners]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> The planet utilized at least some form of organized security force, consisting of a number of probe droids. The [[Brekken Gang]] maintained some presence on the planet.

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]] it was also the place in which the ''[[Gilded Star]]'', a massive [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] was hiding in deep atmosphere, beneath sight and scan range. In [[3630 BBY]], [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Gault Rennow]] and his partner [[Vette]] planned a [[Raid on the Gilded Star|heist]] of the Guilded Star, for which they recruited Gault's old acquaintance [[Dretcher]] and a contingent of forces from [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]], including [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], [[Lana Beniko]], [[Theron Shan]], [[Senya Tirall]] and [[SCORPIO]]. The group was able to get onboard and plant a missile warhead inside the vault, which vaporized its entire content of precious metals, which was then pumped into a tanker, before making their getaway.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Vandin_concept_art.jpg|thumb|250px|Concept art of Vandin]]
Vandin first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 13: Profit and Plunder'''.<ref name="SWTOR" /> It later also makes an appearance in the [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] map Sky Shredder as the host location for said map.<ref name="Huttball">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1022018/game-update-5.9.3-fame-and-fortune|text=Game Update 5.9.3: Fame and Fortune Patch Notes}}</ref>
